d:
US Vice President JD Vance has defended Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, saying the Trump administration received assurances that Huang was not under investigation and that there was no evidence of criminal wrongdoing.
Speaking to reporters in Ohio, Vance dismissed allegations against Huang, arguing that accusations based on anonymous media reports should not be treated as established facts.
Vance also stressed Nvidia's importance in America's AI race against China, saying the company must strictly comply with US export controls to prevent advanced AI chips from reaching the wrong hands.
